name: microtasks
description: Let Claude read and change your Microtasks board, open in your browser.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to the Microtasks tab in your browser (https://microtasks.endura.works). Claude can read the board, push a whole breakdown of tasks, microtasks and nanotasks with notes, edit, regroup, and move tasks to the Recycle bin. Runs on your computer; nothing leaves it. Open https://microtasks.endura.works/#mcp once to connect.
